experiments.hypothesis: a ride-sound-only reel (no music, 'sound on' hook) may hold viewers as well as or better than music reels because it stands out in the feed
experiments.successCriterion: hold clearly above the week's music reels of similar length (≥5 pp); otherwise inconclusive — one reel can't settle it

experiments.hypothesis: a seamless swap-halves loop may raise watch-through because replays count as watch time
experiments.successCriterion: watch-through materially above comparable short non-loop reels (≥15 pp); otherwise inconclusive

experiments.hypothesis: opening on teammates' real dialogue with transcript captions (no setup shot) may hold better than text-led reels
experiments.successCriterion: hold repeatedly above text-led reels of similar length; otherwise inconclusive

experiments.hypothesis: mixing in this week's trending songs may lift likes per reach versus last week's free tracks (audio page discovery)
experiments.successCriterion: a repeated, large difference in likes/reach (and reach, noted separately) across ≥3 reels each; treat as observational

experiments.hypothesis: putting the question on screen as the last text beat may earn more comments than asking only in the caption, since most viewers never open the caption
experiments.successCriterion: any repeated comments on test reels while controls stay at zero; with one or two reels each this is only suggestive, otherwise inconclusive

experiments.hypothesis: doing a trend's actual on-screen format, not just using its song, may lift engagement per reach
experiments.successCriterion: engagement/reach clearly above comparable group-ride reels using a trending song only, across both tests; otherwise inconclusive

strengths: audience: reels with a person and a real moment lead on reach and 3 s hold: first-ride-back reach 513 / hold 63.0%, wake-the-roommate reach 298 / hold 75.8%, vs scenery reels golden-bridge 46.2%, bike-trip 43.6%, empty-roads 45.9% (analytics/2026-11-08T210702.json; several samples under 7 days, observational)
audience: short reels hold attention: multitool-drain 7.7 s 85.1% watch-through, elevator-loop 7.2 s 75.8% (under 48 h), wake-the-roommate 11.5 s 66.1%; 15-16 s montages 24.2-33.7% (same pull)
production: the Nov 2-8 batch was approved without edits (memory/batch-2026-11-02; learning/feedback.jsonl status events)
weaknesses: audience: still 0 comments on all 12 measured reels; likes 0-3, saves 1 in total, shares 2 in total (analytics/2026-11-08T210702.json)
audience: trending songs show no visible lift in likes yet: test reels 0-1 likes on 121-298 reach; most samples under 7 days and format/week are confounded
audience: 2026-11-07 and 2026-11-08 reels were not in the 2026-11-08 pull; unknown, not poor
production: Road to 5 W/kg ep 1 talking-to-camera clips were not in inbox/ or library at this batch, so the series did not start; 11-03 workout clips stay unused for it
footage: 360 clips from 11-07 are mostly stationary at stops when speech happens; a teammate-facing shot of the sprints would have helped (SHOTLIST)
decisions: 2026-11-09-fortnite-before-the-long-ride: apply aud-person-01 and aud-length-01 (face + voice-first, 10 s)
2026-11-14-every-bridge-sprint-zone and 2026-11-15-little-gray: familiar voice-first/face formats, strava: stats only
w45 experiments stay awaiting-data; revisit at the next batch with 7-14 day samples
proposals: none this week that change skills or code

lessons.observation: reels of about 7-12 s with a person and a visible payoff outperform 15-16 s montages on watch-through
evidence: analytics/2026-11-08T210702.json: multitool-drain 85.1%, wake-the-roommate 66.1%, first-ride-back 70.5%; bike-trip 24.2%, chasing-the-group 32.4%, group-ride-chill 33.7%
lessons.nextAction: keep reels 7-13 s; re-check once the Nov 2-8 reels reach 7 days

lessons.observation: a person on screen or a real voice in the first shot holds viewers better than scenery openings
evidence: analytics/2026-11-08T210702.json: first-ride-back, wake-the-roommate, multitool-drain, train-horn holds 63.0-75.8% vs 43.6-50.4% for bike-trip, golden-bridge, empty-roads, bridges
lessons.nextAction: open on a face or voice; don't make scenery-only reels unless the footage is exceptional

lessons.observation: reels are watched but not answered: 0 comments on all 12 measured reels
evidence: analytics/2026-11-08T210702.json: comments 0 on all 12 rows, likes 0-3, reach 116-513
lessons.nextAction: test an on-screen question vs caption-only (2026-w46-onscreen-question); user replies to first comments
